package.description: Create polished screen recordings for free. An open-source screen recorder for Mac/Windows/Linux that adds auto-zooms, animated cursors, auto-captions and more to your videos.

en-US.description: Create polished screen recordings for free. An open-source screen recorder for Mac/Windows/Linux that adds auto-zooms, animated cursors, auto-captions and more to your videos.
en-US.longDescription: Recordly is an open-source screen recorder and editor for walkthroughs, demos, tutorials, product videos, and social clips. Record a screen or window, jump straight into the editor, and export a polished result with cursor effects, zooms, backgrounds, annotations, webcam overlays, and more.
en-US.name: Recordly
